# extract_boundary_persistence { #dyf.extract_boundary_persistence }

```python
extract_boundary_persistence(tree, margin_pct=0.1)
```

Identify points that persist as boundary across multiple tree depths.

Same concept as pca_tree.extract_boundary_persistence but for k-ary DYF
trees.  At each depth, points with centroid similarity below the
margin_pct percentile threshold are tagged as boundary.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                          | Default    |
|------------|--------|--------------------------------------|------------|
| tree       |        | DYF tree dict from build_dyf_tree(). | _required_ |
| margin_pct |        | Percentile threshold (0-1).          | `0.1`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | dict with: boundary_depths: dict[int, list[int]] boundary_count: np.ndarray shape (n,) thresholds: dict[int, float] |
